item.title: Sat 21 Nov: Anthropic's raise grows, then slides
item.description: Anthropic's IPO grows to about ninety-three billion dollars before shares slide on day two. Also: OpenAI gates router access to its models, and Apple, Google and Replit push agents that run whole computers.
